senior bureaucrats in the Department of Social Security were able to influence the direction and shape of the Working Nation package of reforms.

the role played by senior administrative officers in the social policy-making process.
the role of bureaucrats in the social policy process.

the Working Nation package was a bureaucratic triumph.
